answer: Each AI joins a horizon‑indexed trellis where its public key must co‑sign a time‑locked prism vault that aggregates payment deposits from all linked identities; the vault only opens after a 48‑hour quorum of distinct keys signs, proving a shared financial source. An attacker who forges N identities must lock $10 × N USD in the vault and wait the full 48 hours for each fake to become spendable, otherwise the quorum never forms. The combined lock‑up and delay make a Sybil surge economically prohibitive.
